channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: AJ Barner caught 1-of-3 targets for 12 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 4 win over the Chargers.
Rashid Shaheed caught 1-of-3 targets for 20 yards and rushed twice for 33 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks’ Week 4 win over the Chargers.
Jauan Jennings caught 1-of-1 targets for eight yards in the Vikings’ Week 4 win over the Saints.
item.description: Jennings simply isn’t meaningfully involved in the Vikings’ game plan. That is unlikely to change in Week 5 against the Saints, especially with the Vikings’ offensive line getting banged up in Week 4. Jennings could be asked to contribute more as a run blocker next week.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 5-of-6 targets for 78 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 4 win over the Chargers.
Orande Gadsden II caught 5-of-8 targets for 36 yards in the Chargers’ Week 4 loss to the Seahawks.
Vikings coach Kevin O’Connell said he does not know if Justin Jefferson (ankle) will play in Week 5 against the Saints.
item.description: Jefferson made “great progress” this week, according to O’Connell, but it is still too early to say whether the Vikings’ star wide receiver will be good to go. Jefferson did not practice at all in Week 4. Hopefully, he is feeling well enough to resume practicing by Wednesday. Stay tuned.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Quentin Johnston caught 1-of-2 targets for 44 yards in the Chargers’ Week 4 loss to the Seahawks.
Tre Harris caught 3-of-5 targets for 60 yards in the Chargers’ Week 4 loss to the Seahawks.
Keaton Mitchell rushed 10 times for 39 yards while catching five passes for 24 yards in the Chargers’ Week 4 loss to the Seahawks.
item.description: Mitchell, Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal were both equally involved in the rushing attack, and that’s not really a compliment to anyone in this group.- Christopher Crawford

item.title: Jordan Addison caught 4-of-6 targets for 52 yards in the Vikings’ Week 4 win over the Dolphins.
item.description: Addison’s box score could have looked a little bit better, had his 21-yard gain on a curl route during the Vikings’ third drive not been erased by a penalty. Regardless, he played sidekick to T.J. Hockenson in this one. For his part, Addison maximized his opportunity, delivering the longest play of the game via a 27-yard catch on a crosser in which he barreled through multiple Dolphins defenders to generate extra yardage. The Vikings also gave him the ball on a jet sweep, but he lost one yard on it. Addison will be a WR3 against the Saints next week if Justin Jefferson (ankle) is still sidelined.-Nic Bodiford
